SystemState.title: SystemState
SystemState.description: Global bootstrap configuration storing primary admin UID and SHA-256 hashes of authorized admin emails without exposing raw PII.

primaryAdminUid.description: UID of the primary administrator who bootstrapped the app.

adminEmailHashes.description: Bounded list (max 50) of lowercase SHA-256 hex hashes of authorized admin emails.

CentralDriveConfig.title: CentralDriveConfig
CentralDriveConfig.description: Central 5TB Google Drive vault authorization and folder configuration activated by the primary admin (abdallahxh909@gmail.com) at /system_state/drive_config for all admins and students.

primaryAdminEmail.description: Email of the primary admin (abdallahxh909@gmail.com) owning the 5TB Google Drive.

primaryAdminUid.description: UID of the primary admin who activated the central 5TB Drive vault.

vaultFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID for Elghaliz_Medicine_5TB_Vault.

accessToken.description: Active Google Drive OAuth2 access token with drive.file scope.

refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token or server auth token for automatic renewal.

tokenExpiresAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the current accessToken expires.

isEnabled.description: Whether the central 5TB Google Drive vault is active.

AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Verified admin membership document keyed by authenticated user UID.

emailHash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the admin's lowercase email.

isPrimary.description: Whether this admin is the primary administrator.

AdminEntry.title: AdminEntry
AdminEntry.description: Admin directory entry managed exclusively by admins, isolated from student access.

email.description: Lowercase email address of the authorized admin/doctor.

emailHash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the lowercase email address.

roleTitle.description: Title or role description of the doctor/admin.

addedByUid.description: UID of the admin who added this entry.

isPrimary.description: Whether this entry belongs to the primary bootstrap admin.

scopeKey.description: Scope key for admin list queries.

StudentRequest.title: StudentRequest
StudentRequest.description: Student registration and approval state managed by admins (pending, approved, suspended).

status.description: Approval status controlled exclusively by admins.

scopeKey.description: Scope key for admin list queries.

registeredDeviceIds.description: Server-enforced list of registered device IDs (max 2 devices per student account).

CourseRequest.title: CourseRequest
CourseRequest.description: Per-category (course) enrollment request and approval status for a specific student and category.

userId.description: UID of the student requesting or enrolled in the course.

status.description: Course subscription status controlled by admins.

scopeKey.description: Scope key for admin list queries.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Medical subject or academic category created by an authorized admin/doctor.

description.description: Brief description of the medical subject.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin/doctor who created this category.

createdByName.description: Display name of the doctor who created this category.

Lecture.title: Lecture
Lecture.description: Video lecture uploaded by a doctor from the phone or saved from a recorded live meeting.

description.description: Detailed description and medical notes for the lecture.

categoryId.description: ID of the parent academic category.

categoryName.description: Denormalized name of the academic category.

uploadedByUid.description: UID of the doctor who uploaded the lecture.

videoSourceUri.description: URI or internal file path of the uploaded video.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the video lecture in seconds.

fileSizeMb.description: Size of the video in megabytes.

chunkCount.description: Number of binary video chunks stored in the video_chunks subcollection.

isRecordedMeeting.description: Whether this lecture was saved from a live meeting recording.

LectureVideoChunk.title: LectureVideoChunk
LectureVideoChunk.description: Base64-encoded binary MP4 video chunk uploaded from the doctor's phone for student streaming and offline download.

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based index of the binary video chunk.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded MP4 binary bytes for this chunk.

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: Built-in native interactive medical lecture session hosted by an admin/doctor inside the app.

title.description: Topic of the live medical meeting.

presentationMode.description: Active display mode in the native live room (doctor camera vs medical slides/screen).

currentSlideIndex.description: Current slide index when sharing medical slides.

studentsMuted.description: Whether the doctor has muted all student microphones.

raisedHandsCount.description: Number of students currently raising their hand.

status.description: Current status of the live meeting.

isRecording.description: Whether the built-in recorder is actively recording the live session.

isScreenSharing.description: Whether the doctor is currently sharing their screen/slides.

participantCount.description: Number of connected students and doctors.

MeetingMessage.title: MeetingMessage
MeetingMessage.description: In-room live chat message or question sent during a native live meeting.

meetingId.description: ID of the parent live meeting.

isHandRaise.description: Whether this message represents a student raising their hand.

OfflineDownload.title: OfflineDownload
OfflineDownload.description: Per-user record of a lecture saved strictly inside internal app storage for offline viewing.

userId.description: UID of the student who downloaded the lecture.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

ExamItem.title: ExamItem
ExamItem.description: Timed PDF exam uploaded by an admin/doctor for a specific academic course, downloadable unencrypted to student phones during the scheduled window.

description.description: Instructions or notes for the exam.

categoryId.description: ID of the parent academic category (course).

categoryName.description: Name of the parent academic category (course).

uploadedByUid.description: UID of the admin/doctor who uploaded the exam.

doctorName.description: Name of the doctor who uploaded the exam.

pdfFileName.description: Original or display PDF file name.

fileSizeKb.description: Size of the PDF file in kilobytes.

chunkCount.description: Number of Base64 PDF chunks stored in pdf_chunks subcollection.

startTimeMillis.description: Scheduled start timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

endTimeMillis.description: Scheduled end timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

scheduleLabel.description: Formatted Arabic schedule string (Day, Date, From time -> To time).

ExamPdfChunk.title: ExamPdfChunk
ExamPdfChunk.description: Base64-encoded binary PDF chunk for an exam.

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based index of the PDF chunk.

CourseNotification.title: CourseNotification
CourseNotification.description: Course-scoped notification broadcast when an admin uploads a new lecture or exam.

targetItemId.description: ID of the newly uploaded lecture or exam.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who triggered the notification.

/system_state/{configId}.description: Global bootstrap state and hashed admin email allowlist.

/admin_members/{userId}.description: Verified admin membership documents keyed by UID.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Admin directory entries readable and writable exclusively by admins.

/student_requests/{studentId}.description: Student join requests and approval statuses controlled by admins.

/course_requests/{requestId}.description: Per-category (course) enrollment requests and approvals for students.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Academic medical categories created by admins.

/lectures/{lectureId}.description: Medical video lectures uploaded by admins or recorded from live meetings.

/lectures/{lectureId}/video_chunks/{chun.description: Binary MP4 video chunks uploaded by the doctor for student streaming and in-app download.

/meetings/{meetingId}.description: Native built-in live meetings hosted by admins and joined by approved students.

/meetings/{meetingId}/messages/{messageI.description: Real-time chat questions and hand-raise events inside a native live meeting.

/users/{userId}/downloads/{lectureId}.description: Student-owned offline download metadata for internal app storage.

/exams/{examId}.description: Timed PDF exams organized by course.

/exams/{examId}/pdf_chunks/{chunkId}.description: Unencrypted PDF chunks for direct download to student phones.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Course-scoped notifications for new lectures and exams.
